brief:
Shehab Wire reported that Palestinian journalists including Ammar and Hassan remain under threat during Israel's three-year military campaign in Gaza. The reporters face persecution, displacement, and food insecurity while lacking protective equipment and work tools, yet continue documenting casualties from what the outlet describes as genocide.

The journalists have persisted in covering the conflict despite losing access to basic resources and facing ongoing danger. Their reporting has maintained a record of war casualties as fighting continues in the territory.

title: Palestinian journalists detained amid Gaza war continue reporting despite hardship
